title: 挂甲屯 (华家屯) Guajiatun (Huajiatun)
subtitle: a village · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 40 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls). Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a village outside the garden walls

facts.label: Where
facts.value: S1008 bounds (E 万泉河, S 承泽园, W 万泉河路, N 颐和园路): centre read, C; its extent, a circle of 80 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 日下 j80:1a '圓明園在掛甲屯之北'; j99:25b 前/后华家屯 (the garden granted at 后华家屯). S1008 dates the name to the Ming. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 2045,460, fit rms 95 m (Kwakiatun (?)), 200 m from the point used.
